listing.name: Pharaoh (Akhenaten)
listing.summary: Research listing. Upstream route: Native recreation with CI builds; initial campaign missions playable according to upstream. Limits: Work in progress with early campaign support; no stable-release claim and original Pharaoh demo unsupported. Upstream platforms: Windows/Linux and macOS ARM64/x86-64 CI archives plus official itch.io distribution; selected Windows/Linux CPU artifacts unknown in frozen docs. WIP rather than stable release. Original data: WIP, no stable release in README; original Pharaoh data, NOT Pharaoh: A New Era assets. Portcove setup/gameplay not verified.
